Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Wire package PairingSession and composite storage into existing Channels.LinkedDevice facade, PairLinkedDevice Action and supervisor. Explicitly start package infrastructure before host preparation/pairing/listeners. Use upstream lifecycle and thin host callbacks, preserving BO response shapes, owner checks, identity guard, retry/cancel/expiry and saved/runtime_pending. Delete lib/zaq/channels/linked_device/session.ex, temporary_storage.ex, storage.ex and session_storage.ex; the entire directory must be absent. Remove obsolete references/config/test support and duplicate implementations. Keep linked_device.ex outside the directory only for host configuration/binding/lifecycle glue; no renamed state machine elsewhere. Audit Mnesia consumers before altering shared app/schema config. Preserve the local dependency override for development.

Tests to add before implementation:
Before edits adapt real onboarding/storage/supervision/restart tests through existing Actions and actual package APIs. Preserve operator/binding denial, stale identity, frozen save retry, idempotent confirm, one-time seed, logout both stores, post-save start failure and multi-account behavior. Move generic unit/property coverage upstream while retaining host authorization/persistence integration assertions. Final source/reference audit proves all four modules and directory are gone without renamed duplicates.

Branches/paths validated:
Provisional/confirmed; allowed/denied operator; stale/current identity and attempt; saved/runtime_pending; revoked credentials; multiple accounts; node/Mnesia restart.

Mocking plan:
Real internal collaborators; inject external transport/host-callback edges only. Isolated BEAMs for global Mnesia. Explicit config/clock/dependency options.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
ZAQ channels/system-config owner docs and module docs updated for complete upstream ownership; no UI redesign.

Action reuse assessment:
Consume upstream prerequisites and existing host Actions/events. Remove duplicated mechanisms rather than relocating them. Preserve confidential NodeRouter execution boundaries; no new agent tools.

Validation and E2E:
Read owning AGENTS.md and ZAQ workflow, action-reuse, testing, system-config and documentation policies as applicable. Use real internal state/process/DB boundaries; mock only external WhatsApp transport or package host-callback boundary in upstream standalone tests. Isolate global Mnesia tests in separate BEAMs. Runtime dependency seams use explicit public options. Preserve current UI journeys; run relevant existing tests, no new feature E2E authoring unless scope changes and the required UX approval is recorded. Follow post-review coverage and final validation gates; no automatic commit/push/publication.
